method: Inventory derived by fs walk + generated ledgers. Mapping authored by the audit agent after reading every RI title/front-matter, every plan heading, and every open gap record.

rings.0: Instruments — how we know anything. Continuous; never "finished".
rings.1: The frame — what a rendered pixel looks like. Wave 1 by owner directive.
rings.2: The body, the camera and the fight — Souls owns everything in here.
rings.3: The world you can navigate by prose — the substrate B-side quests stand on.
rings.4: The character and the economies — what you become and what it costs.
rings.5: People, words and quests — the Morrowind half proper.
rings.6: The platform — save, input, performance, screens.
rings.7: The whole thing — judged as an experience, end to end.

proposed_items.title: The harness and determinism
proposed_items.blurb: Harness API surface, seeded PRNG actually drawn, fixed-step reproducibility, save-shape probes.

proposed_items.title: Capture and the Deck
proposed_items.blurb: Hardware capture that returns frames under fleet load; many angles + motion as the standing evidence form.

proposed_items.title: Consumption as a gate
proposed_items.blurb: RI-MTH07 enforced on every piece: the world reads the model, demonstrated by perturbation.

proposed_items.title: The corpus audited and extended
proposed_items.blurb: Citation tripwire, the missing instruments, reference plates that can satisfy their own rows, region/topological maps.

proposed_items.title: The blind protocols
proposed_items.blurb: Protocol A (fidelity) and Protocol B (art direction), packs that can express the question their item asks. Runs after I5: a pack that cannot separate quality from provenance is not a judgement.

proposed_items.title: The camera
proposed_items.blurb: Third-person rig, spring arm, collision pull-in, lock-on framing, camera-relative movement, the camera outside the fight. Scheduled in ring 1, not ring 2: every visual verdict on the player body is taken through it.

proposed_items.title: Materials and surface response
proposed_items.blurb: PBR sets bound to what is drawn; roughness, edge wear, wetness. DONE and evidenced on hardware.

proposed_items.title: Shadow, contact and ambient occlusion
proposed_items.blurb: Contact darkening, soft-where-soft, cascades. The judges’ most universal observation, 5 of 5.

proposed_items.title: Ambient and bounce fill
proposed_items.blurb: GI/ambient so shadows stop crushing to black; tone-mapped shadow lift.

proposed_items.title: Light, sky and atmosphere
proposed_items.blurb: Sun and moons, time of day, fog model, aerial perspective, cloud.

proposed_items.title: The frame pipeline
proposed_items.blurb: Antialiasing, exposure, bloom, tonemapping, grade by region/time/weather; the renderer feature checklist.

proposed_items.title: Terrain and vegetation surfaces
proposed_items.blurb: Terrain texturing/blending/wear; species, density, LOD, wind, canopy shimmer.

proposed_items.title: The water surface
proposed_items.blurb: Surface, shore, depth, refraction; the axis-aligned lane defect.

proposed_items.title: The building kit and settlement silhouette
proposed_items.blurb: Kit parts, grammars, roof profiles, silhouette variety, and the reuse library that makes a good model teach the next one.

proposed_items.title: Interiors and practical light
proposed_items.blurb: Torches, lanterns, emissives, interior light falloff — and the light field stealth has to read.

proposed_items.title: Characters and creatures
proposed_items.blurb: Model quality, silhouette readability, the player’s body under an always-behind camera.

proposed_items.title: Animation quality
proposed_items.blurb: Locomotion, transitions, weight, recovery. Couples to G3; Souls owns the fight, so G3 governs where they meet.

proposed_items.title: VFX and particles
proposed_items.blurb: Magic, weather, dust, smoke, impact, blood.

proposed_items.title: Art direction and region identity
proposed_items.blurb: The look target written as numbers, the transposition spec, the "could this be Skyrim?" detector.

proposed_items.title: Performance, LOD and budgets
proposed_items.blurb: Draw distance, instancing, shadow-caster budget, ordinary hardware.

proposed_items.title: Save and load
proposed_items.blurb: The state manifest, the round-trip diff, the storage ruling. Scheduled in ring 2, not with the platform work: equip load, roll class and the purse all currently change when you reload, so nothing downstream can be judged across a session.

proposed_items.title: Controls and discoverability
proposed_items.blurb: Desktop action set and pointer lock, a fresh player with no manual, gamepad lifecycle, mobile with an attached pad. Ahead of G7: judging feel means humans playing.

proposed_items.title: Enemies that can fight you
proposed_items.blurb: Aggro/approach/spacing, telegraph doctrine, punish windows, attack strings, roster archetypes. Ahead of G2: an attack volume that cannot reach contact range makes the exchange untestable from the receiving end.

proposed_items.title: The exchange
proposed_items.blurb: Roll and i-frames, equip-load tiers, stamina economy, hitboxes/hurtboxes, poise, stagger, parry, backstab, riposte, input latency.

proposed_items.title: Weapons and movesets, wired
proposed_items.blurb: The 87 authored movesets reachable from the running game; class differentiation, contextual attacks, two-handing, shields, hitstop and material impact.

proposed_items.title: Bosses and encounter authorship
proposed_items.blurb: Phases, tells, arena, the fog-gate loop; placement, sightlines, density, the ambush and the one you learn to skip.

proposed_items.title: Combat HUD and impact feedback
proposed_items.blurb: What the HUD shows and must never show; stamina as a correctness property; impact audio as frame-critical feedback.

proposed_items.title: How the fight feels
proposed_items.blurb: Reactability, decision divergence, difficulty and the curve — judged by humans playing, never by charts.

proposed_items.title: Healing, status and exhaustion
proposed_items.blurb: The Hist-sap flask and its commitment frames; the five status meters and the handoff to the affliction economy; roll-spam and the exhausted state.

proposed_items.title: Terrain form and the road network
proposed_items.blurb: Landform and geology per region, the terrain grammar, world scale, the one-hour traversal budget, roads that are not underwater.

proposed_items.title: Regions that read differently on foot
proposed_items.blurb: Region identity beyond a colour tint, borders and staggered crossover, the unlabeled-screenshot test.

proposed_items.title: Variety within a region
proposed_items.blurb: The six-minute walk, the patch-size ceiling, density per minute of travel.

proposed_items.title: Settlements with an outside
proposed_items.blurb: Settlement anatomy, exterior fabric for all 202 buildings, layout authored at the generator so buildings stop interpenetrating.

proposed_items.title: Doors, interiors and continuity
proposed_items.blurb: A door you can see, walk through, and come back in by; footprint/bearing/window agreement; verticality and the cave seam.

proposed_items.title: Legibility — landmarks and prose directions
proposed_items.blurb: Landmarks, signposts, and a world you can direct someone across in a sentence. Hard prerequisite for P6.

proposed_items.title: Getting around
proposed_items.blurb: The transport network — modes, routes, fares, stations, walked-it-once — and travel magic: Mark, Recall, the Interventions.

proposed_items.title: Dungeons, xanmeers and ruins
proposed_items.blurb: Places worth entering with rewards worth finding.

proposed_items.title: Water and hazards as play
proposed_items.blurb: Depth bands, wading, swimming, tide, substrate, what standing water does to a fight; the thirteen hazards and the telegraph law.

proposed_items.title: The living world
proposed_items.blurb: Schedules, homes, work, sleep, ecology, ambient events, weather and time as things you plan around.

proposed_items.title: Strangeness and the built alienness
proposed_items.blurb: The thirty things that exist nowhere else, nine architectural grammars, the right-angle census, the opacity budget.

proposed_items.title: Character creation as a played scene
proposed_items.blurb: The Writ House rendered rather than an API: race, birthsigns, the questionnaire, the naming moment, what it changes and never locks.

proposed_items.title: Levelling and the hearth
proposed_items.blurb: The soul cost curve, souls yield, the ten attributes, skills that improve by use, and a level-up screen that exists at the bonfire.

proposed_items.title: Load, inventory and upgrades
proposed_items.blurb: Equip load and encumbrance surviving a save, the inventory screen, the menu-pause rule, the +N upgrade path and its materials.

proposed_items.title: Gold
proposed_items.blurb: Prices by merchant, disposition and region; barter as a conversation; a purse that persists. Souls level you; gold buys things.

proposed_items.title: Affliction and disease
proposed_items.blurb: Seventeen diseases, their causes, their cures, and the one that has none.

proposed_items.title: Magic that does what it says
proposed_items.blurb: The effect catalogue with behaviour behind it, spellmaking and enchanting with a world-side surface, soul gems, combat casting frames, magic as a quest solution.

proposed_items.title: Stealth and theft
proposed_items.blurb: Detection by light/sound/sight, the search, ownership of every object, locks, pickpocketing, trespass, and a fence that will not buy your victim’s own furniture.

proposed_items.title: Crime and justice
proposed_items.blurb: Being seen, the report chain, bounty, guards who can actually fight, arrest, jail, reputation that persists, and faction-sanctioned crime.

proposed_items.title: The topic web and the dialogue window
proposed_items.blurb: Topics that unlock topics, the filter stack and first-match-wins, settlement topic webs, and a window that looks like Morrowind’s.

proposed_items.title: Voice, disposition and persuasion
proposed_items.blurb: Speakers who disagree, greetings and rumours, Admire/Intimidate/Taunt/Bribe, measurable style per archetype, tonal range, and characters who address the player.

proposed_items.title: The journal
proposed_items.blurb: Chronological, append-only, in a person’s voice, searchable, and the only navigation aid. No quest markers, ever — enforced by a detector.

proposed_items.title: Books and readables with a reader
proposed_items.blurb: The 65 texts openable and readable in the world: pagination, legibility, reading as a real activity.

proposed_items.title: Lore, canon and names
proposed_items.blurb: The canon-facts registry and contradiction discipline, Jel phonology and naming, the peoples of the province and what they disagree about, the era brief, religion and metaphysics.

proposed_items.title: A quest end to end without markers
proposed_items.blurb: Rumour → giver → prose direction → landmark → resolution → journal. Depends on W6.

proposed_items.title: Quest givers who exist, and ladders that open
proposed_items.blurb: The 94 quest givers standing somewhere a player can reach, and faction ranks past 5 opening the 21 already-authored quests.

proposed_items.title: Factions with real ladders
proposed_items.blurb: Joining, rank, duties, expulsion, rivalry, exclusivity — belonging somewhere costing you somewhere else.

proposed_items.title: The main quest
proposed_items.blurb: Five acts and a backpath, enterable and advanceable by playing rather than by harness.

proposed_items.title: Quest texture and consequence
proposed_items.blurb: Type distribution and density, quests you have to overhear, unique-named rewards, non-combat resolution and the parley, irreversibility and mutually exclusive endings.

proposed_items.title: Load, streaming and budgets
proposed_items.blurb: Time to first playable, silent region borders, hitch census, memory and the ten-minute traversal leak test, the frame budget.

proposed_items.title: The Morrowind screens
proposed_items.blurb: Inventory, map, character sheet, level-up, journal screen, out-of-combat HUD, the dialogue window's look, UI diegesis. Ring 1, not ring 6: these are on screen in the first few minutes, we hold Morrowind interface references for them, and several already score at or near the bar.

proposed_items.title: The opening
proposed_items.blurb: First launch to first meaningful choice as an unbroken act; the opening as an exchange; the first-hour beat sheet.

proposed_items.title: The first hour as interaction
proposed_items.blurb: What the hands do, and when the player becomes competent.

proposed_items.title: Death and recovery
proposed_items.blurb: Die, lose your souls, respawn, run back, get them back. Checkpoint spacing as level design.

proposed_items.title: Cross-system payoff and emergence
proposed_items.blurb: The seam-sterility floor, the fuzzing protocol for combinations nobody wrote, the permissiveness budget.

proposed_items.title: Build identity
proposed_items.blurb: Six archetypes each taken through the whole game and arriving somewhere different.

proposed_items.title: Session shape and pacing
proposed_items.blurb: The twenty-hour curve, the mid-game sag, the novelty decay, the anecdote census.

proposed_items.title: Endings and the last hour
proposed_items.blurb: The approach, the point of no return, and what the world says about what you did.

proposed_items.blurb: Can a cold player rebuild their own intentions from in-game information alone.

proposed_items.title: Sound

dependencies.why: The sneak model reads a light field that is saturated: 71.8% of interior cells read L = 1.0000.
Gold lives in two places and the spendable one has no writer, so the economy does not survive a reload.
A save and a reload change your roll class, so equip-load tiers cannot be judged across a session.
Levelling happens only at the hearth screen, and the hearth gate calls a method that does not exist; creation never reaches a scene to set the stats it levels.
The player body is judged under an always-behind camera; you cannot inspect a body you cannot orbit.

dependencies.why: The moveset animation model has no rendered consumer, so weapon identity cannot be seen.
An enemy attack volume that cannot reach contact range makes the exchange untestable from the receiving end.
Region identity is currently a tint over three shared primitives; distinguishing regions is a terrain and air problem before it is a colour problem.
A door cannot be drawn into a building whose exterior does not exist.
Creation cannot be completed from the title screen, so the opening has no first act.
The corpse run is a souls economy, and SoulsSystem._alive is keyed on eid with nothing authorised to clear it.
All four positional emitters compute every frame and produce no sound on any device.
A blind pack that cannot separate quality from provenance is not a judgement.
